about: Launch buttons, one per style (step 138, src/studio/styles.py). The style ids come from the templates (motion/src/registry.ts STYLES and the cinematic engine); an id here that no template has is ignored, a style missing here still shows with its registry label. preview: files under data/samples/ (a missing file = no preview). end_card: the end-card style (motion/src/endcards/schema.ts END_CARD_STYLES). address: tu or vous. enabled: the default, the owner changes it in Settings.
